## Build faster with
world-class tooling

From your first API call to processing millions — Paygent developer experience is designed for speed, reliability, and scale.

RESTful APIs

Clean, predictable, and fully documented REST APIs for every payment workflow.

SDKs & Libraries

Official SDKs for Node.js, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, Java, and more.

Webhooks

Real-time event notifications with retry logic and delivery guarantees.

Sandbox Testing

Full-featured test environment to simulate any payment scenario.

paygent-quickstart.js

const paygent = require('paygent')('pgt_live_key');

// Create a payment intent

const intent = await paygent.paymentIntents.create({

amount: 25000,

currency: 'usd',

metadata: { orderId: 'ord_1234' },

});

// Confirm the payment

const result = await paygent.paymentIntents.confirm(

intent.id

);

// { status: 'succeeded', amount: 25000 }
